Name: Vanilla Tweaks-Better Honey Mead Compatibility Patch
Author: vivelox
Description: This is a patch between [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22848]Better Honey Mead[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21437]Vanilla Tweaks[/url] to allow the use of Vanilla Tweaks's honey and mead sprites with Better Honey Mead's functionality and sprite color changes! You will need both of those mods for this patch to function. Thanks to ncarigon and mrtaiyou for allowing me to make this patch :)

Downloads.Description: Initial upload. Make sure you download both Better Honey Mead and Vanilla Tweaks - Producer Edition!
